package streamwrite

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

// The projected Write method is byte-exact production source. These dependencies
// are explicit deterministic protocol doubles, not a native network or guest.
const lsfStreamMaximumChunk = 16384

var ErrClosed = errors.New("closed")
var errBusy = errors.New("busy")
var now time.Time

func lsfStreamTimeout(deadline time.Time) (uint32, error) {
	if deadline.IsZero() {
		return 0, nil
	}
	if !deadline.After(now) {
		return 0, context.DeadlineExceeded
	}
	return uint32(deadline.Sub(now) / time.Millisecond), nil
}

type streamFailure struct {
	AcceptedPrefixBytes uint32
	MayHaveApplied      bool
}
type lsfStreamError struct{ failure streamFailure }

func (e *lsfStreamError) Error() string { return "closed-stream-failure" }

type result struct {
	n       uint32
	failure *streamFailure
}

func (r result) IsErr() bool        { return r.failure != nil }
func (r result) Err() streamFailure { return *r.failure }
func (r result) Ok() uint32         { return r.n }

type call struct {
	bytes   []byte
	timeout uint32
}
type wire struct {
	calls    []call
	accepted []byte
	replies  []result
	after    func(int)
	owner    *lsfStreamConn
}

func (w *wire) WriteContext(_ context.Context, b []byte, timeout uint32) result {
	if !w.owner.busy {
		panic("write direction escaped original owner")
	}
	if len(b) > lsfStreamMaximumChunk {
		panic("host chunk bound widened")
	}
	w.calls = append(w.calls, call{append([]byte(nil), b...), timeout})
	r := result{n: uint32(len(b))}
	if len(w.replies) > 0 {
		r = w.replies[0]
		w.replies = w.replies[1:]
	}
	n := r.n
	if r.IsErr() {
		n = r.Err().AcceptedPrefixBytes
	}
	if int(n) <= len(b) {
		w.accepted = append(w.accepted, b[:n]...)
	}
	if w.after != nil {
		w.after(len(w.calls))
	}
	return r
}

type lsfStreamConn struct {
	mu                       sync.Mutex
	stream                   *wire
	writeShut, busy, closing bool
	writeDeadline            time.Time
	admissions, releases     int
}

func (c *lsfStreamConn) begin(_ bool) (uint32, func(), error) {
	if c.closing {
		return 0, nil, ErrClosed
	}
	if c.busy {
		return 0, nil, errBusy
	}
	timeout, err := lsfStreamTimeout(c.writeDeadline)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, nil, err
	}
	c.busy = true
	c.admissions++
	return timeout, func() {
		if !c.busy {
			panic("duplicate release")
		}
		c.busy = false
		c.releases++
	}, nil
}
func (c *lsfStreamConn) opError(op string, e error) error { return fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", op, e) }
func conn() *lsfStreamConn {
	c := &lsfStreamConn{stream: &wire{}}
	c.stream.owner = c
	now = time.Unix(1, 0)
	return c
}
func heldOnce(t *testing.T, c *lsfStreamConn) {
	t.Helper()
	if c.busy || c.admissions != 1 || c.releases != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("original-owner-not-retired: %d/%d/%t", c.admissions, c.releases, c.busy)
	}
}
func payload(n int) []byte {
	b := make([]byte, n)
	for i := range b {
		b[i] = byte(i % 251)
	}
	return b
}

type reader struct{ io.Reader } // Hide bytes.Reader.WriteTo: ordinary io.Copy's 32KiB path.
func TestCopyCrossesChunkBoundary(t *testing.T) {
	c := conn()
	data := payload(40 * 1024)
	n, err := io.Copy(c, reader{bytes.NewReader(data)})
	if err != nil || n != int64(len(data)) || !bytes.Equal(c.stream.accepted, data) {
		t.Fatalf("chunk-boundary-copy: n=%d error=%v accepted=%d", n, err, len(c.stream.accepted))
	}
	if len(c.stream.calls) != 3 || c.admissions != 2 || c.releases != 2 {
		t.Fatal("copy-chunk-count-or-owner-scope")
	}
	for _, call := range c.stream.calls {
		if len(call.bytes) > 16384 {
			t.Fatal("chunk-bound-widened")
		}
	}
}
func TestDirectWriteAdvancesOnlyAcceptedBytes(t *testing.T) {
	c := conn()
	data := payload(40 * 1024)
	c.stream.replies = []result{{n: 11}, {n: 5}}
	n, err := c.Write(data)
	if err != nil || n != len(data) || !bytes.Equal(c.stream.accepted, data) {
		t.Fatalf("positive-prefix-progress: %d/%v", n, err)
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(c.stream.calls[1].bytes, data[11:11+16384]) || !bytes.Equal(c.stream.calls[2].bytes, data[16:16+16384]) {
		t.Fatal("accepted-byte-replay")
	}
	heldOnce(t, c)
}
func TestErrorKeepsCumulativePrefixAndUncertaintyWithoutRetry(t *testing.T) {
	c := conn()
	data := payload(40 * 1024)
	c.stream.replies = []result{{n: 16384}, {failure: &streamFailure{7, true}}}
	n, err := c.Write(data)
	var failure *lsfStreamError
	if n != 16391 || !errors.As(err, &failure) || failure.failure.AcceptedPrefixBytes != 16391 || !failure.failure.MayHaveApplied {
		t.Fatal("cumulative-uncertain-prefix-lost")
	}
	if len(c.stream.calls) != 2 || !bytes.Equal(c.stream.accepted, data[:n]) {
		t.Fatal("error-retried-or-prefix-replayed")
	}
	heldOnce(t, c)
}
func TestZeroProgressStopsWithoutSpin(t *testing.T) {
	c := conn()
	c.stream.replies = []result{{n: 0}}
	n, err := c.Write(payload(40 * 1024))
	if n != 0 || !errors.Is(err, io.ErrShortWrite) || len(c.stream.calls) != 1 {
		t.Fatal("zero-progress-spun")
	}
	heldOnce(t, c)
}
func TestAbsoluteDeadlineDoesNotRestartForEachFragment(t *testing.T) {
	c := conn()
	c.writeDeadline = now.Add(3 * time.Millisecond)
	c.stream.after = func(_ int) { now = now.Add(2 * time.Millisecond) }
	n, err := c.Write(payload(40 * 1024))
	if n != 32768 || !errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) || len(c.stream.calls) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("original-deadline-not-enforced: %d/%v/%d", n, err, len(c.stream.calls))
	}
	if c.stream.calls[0].timeout != 3 || c.stream.calls[1].timeout != 1 {
		t.Fatal("per-fragment-timeout-reset")
	}
	heldOnce(t, c)
}
func TestSameDirectionRefusalAndSingleOwnerSurviveAllFragments(t *testing.T) {
	c := conn()
	c.stream.after = func(_ int) {
		_, _, err := c.begin(true)
		if !errors.Is(err, errBusy) {
			t.Fatal("competing-write-admitted")
		}
	}
	if _, err := c.Write(payload(40 * 1024)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	heldOnce(t, c)
}
func TestImpossibleCountsFailClosedBeforeAnotherDispatch(t *testing.T) {
	for _, r := range []result{{n: 16385}, {failure: &streamFailure{16385, true}}} {
		c := conn()
		c.stream.replies = []result{r}
		func() {
			defer func() {
				if recover() == nil {
					t.Fatal("foreign-count-accepted")
				}
			}()
			_, _ = c.Write(payload(40 * 1024))
		}()
		if len(c.stream.calls) != 1 {
			t.Fatal("foreign-count-dispatched-again")
		}
		heldOnce(t, c)
	}
}
func TestEmptyClosedAndHalfClosedPathsKeepAdmissionRules(t *testing.T) {
	c := conn()
	if n, err := c.Write(nil); n != 0 || err != nil || len(c.stream.calls) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("empty-dispatch")
	}
	heldOnce(t, c)
	c = conn()
	c.closing = true
	if _, err := c.Write([]byte{1}); !errors.Is(err, ErrClosed) || len(c.stream.calls) != 0 || c.admissions != 0 {
		t.Fatal("closed-admitted")
	}
	c = conn()
	c.writeShut = true
	if _, err := c.Write([]byte{1}); !errors.Is(err, ErrClosed) || len(c.stream.calls) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("half-closed-dispatch")
	}
	heldOnce(t, c)
}
func TestCloseBetweenFragmentsKeepsPrefixAndStopsDispatch(t *testing.T) {
	for _, half := range []bool{false, true} {
		c := conn()
		c.stream.after = func(_ int) {
			c.mu.Lock()
			if half {
				c.writeShut = true
			} else {
				c.closing = true
			}
			c.mu.Unlock()
		}
		n, err := c.Write(payload(40 * 1024))
		if n != 16384 || !errors.Is(err, ErrClosed) || len(c.stream.calls) != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("close-between-fragments: n=%d error=%v calls=%d", n, err, len(c.stream.calls))
		}
		heldOnce(t, c)
	}
}
